usageNotes: Triggers an on-demand refresh of the Proxmox VE subscription status for the specified node by contacting the Proxmox licensing server; the result is cached locally so normal reads use GET instead. Use the `force` flag when a subscription key was just activated or renewed and the cached status is stale. Requires `Sys.Modify` on `/nodes/{node}` and the node must be reachable by the PVE host to contact the upstream server.

examples.summary: Force-refresh subscription status on node pve1 after renewing a license key

tips: Without force=true, the call is a no-op when the local cache is still within its validity window — use force=true after any key change.
Returns null on success; treat an HTTP 2xx with null body as confirmation the refresh was queued.
If the node cannot reach shop.proxmox.com (e.g., air-gapped), the call will fail or leave the node in an 'offline' subscription state — whitelist the licensing endpoint in firewall rules first.
Use GET /nodes/{node}/subscription afterward to confirm the updated status and expiry date.
